title: Button
description: A polymorphic button component that renders as button, anchor, span, or merges into a child element via asChild.

asChild.description: Merges button props onto a child element via Slot.

disabled.description: Disables interaction and applies disabled styling.

startIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon rendered before the button label.

endIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon rendered after the button label.

loading.description: Shows a loading spinner and disables interaction.

loadingText.description: React.ReactNode — Text displayed alongside the loading spinner.

loaderPosition.description: Which side of the label the loader appears on.

loaderSize.description: Pixel size of the loading spinner.

loader.description: React.ReactNode — Custom loader element replacing the default spinner.

fullWidth.description: Stretches the button to fill its container width.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for button sub-elements.

unstyled.description: Removes all default styling, rendering a plain element.

iconAnimation.description: Animation applied to icons on hover.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting.

tooltip.description: React.ReactNode — Tooltip content shown on hover.

tooltipProps.description: Configuration for tooltip positioning and appearance.
